agent_explanation: Actuated mode terminates NS yellow after only 1s instead of required 3s. With actuated=true, NS green -> NS yellow at step 325 -> all-red at 326, giving 1s yellow. With actuated=false the same traffic pattern respects yellow duration. Likely the controller's demand/recall logic that ends green early is also applied to yellow phase, or it forces transition to all-red/EW green when EW has waited, ignoring yellow_seconds minimum. Fix should enforce yellow_seconds even when actuated early termination/recall is active.
